description: This file is a Node.js script written in ES module syntax that implements a file-watching utility. It monitors specified paths for changes and restarts a subprocess when relevant files are added, changed, or deleted. The script manages process signals and integrates with chokidar for filesystem watching, and references an external module './run-node.mjs' for path relevance checks and run logic.

methods.name: runWatchMain
methods.description: Main function that sets up file watching and subprocess management, handling signals and restarts based on file changes.
